tls:text.tls:line: I have learnt,

sense.def: I, your servant (not necessarily minister or even official)

tls:text.tls:line: I have learnt,

sense.def: learn that S, hear that S

sense.def: also under the circumstances specified in S

sense.def: all objects; all objects completely

tls:text.tls:line: but I hope to speak up on everything I have learnt,

sense.def: the object which

tls:text.tls:line: but I hope to speak up on everything I have learnt,

sense.def: learn that S, hear that S

sense.def: Your Great Majesty

tls:text.tls:line: and it is up to the Great King apportion the crimes of which I am thereby guilty.

sense.def: my

tls:text.tls:line: and it is up to the Great King apportion the crimes of which I am thereby guilty.

sense.def: criminal offence, deliberate illegal act; punishable crime; grave fault

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 01.02:01; jiaoshi i45; jishi 1; jiaozhu 2; shiping 1i1

tls:text.tls:line: I have learnt:

sense.def: I, your servant (not necessarily minister or even official)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 01.02:01; jiaoshi i45; jishi 1; jiaozhu 2; shiping 1i1

tls:text.tls:line: I have learnt:

sense.def: be told as a reliable truth; hear about (something); have been told about; learn (from an authoritative source) as true; learn about (a battle or war etc., or a doctrine); later, XUN 1: come to hear, simply acoustically, without connotations of understanding and learning; hear that (something either true or false) CHECK ATTRIBUTIONS!

tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: At this point the Duke had a favourite by the name of Diǎn Jié,

sense.def: At that point, Whereupon; at that time; at this time (remarkably often after direct speeech: having said this,...; then; at that point, at this juncture; at this stage (in a text); and then; subsequently)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: The magistrate asked about the crime he was to be charged with.

sense.def: minor law enforcement officer; police officer; magistrate

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: The magistrate asked about the crime he was to be charged with.

sense.def: ask for information about

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén shed tears and was worried about what to do.

sense.def: His Excellency (applied posthumously to any deceased member of the 諸侯 group) 桓公 Bronze inscriptions have this 公 after deceased persons below 諸侯 rank. [JM]

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén shed tears and was worried about what to do.

sense.def: weep

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén shed tears and was worried about what to do.

sense.def: shed (tears etc)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:06 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén shed tears and was worried about what to do.

sense.def: tears (perhaps with an admixture of snivel)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: In the end he severed Diǎn Jié's backbone

sense.def: cut in two; cut down (trees etc) generalised: cut off (a sleeve etc), sever

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: and displayed his dead body to the noble families

sense.def: display the dead body of an executed person (to some public or group of people) 殉國

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: in order to demonstrate that the law was predictable.

sense.def: make public and clear; promote publicly, make publicly well-known; be publicly clear about, demonstrate publicly

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: in order to demonstrate that the law was predictable.

sense.def: inevitability, reliability

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: After this the noble families all got scared and said:

sense.def: become frightened; become scared

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: "If the ruler, when it comes to a person this noble and powerful like Diǎn Jié,

sense.def: political influence, political weight; political power

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: the ruler still applies the law.

sense.def: enact; implement as an official; carry out as a morally responsible agent; put into practice, practise, carry out; operate according to; implement (a law) and apply it to

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: What problem will there be in applying it to us?"

sense.def: us; our party (which is also yours)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén saw that the people now could be made to fight in war,

sense.def: His Excellency (applied posthumously to any deceased member of the 諸侯 group) 桓公 Bronze inscriptions have this 公 after deceased persons below 諸侯 rank. [JM]

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: Duke Wén saw that the people now could be made to fight in war,

sense.def: cause (the people etc) to fight, send into battle

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: he brought out his army to launch a formal attack on Yuán,

sense.def: then indeed

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: he brought out his army to launch a formal attack on Yuán,

sense.def: mobilise (an army); raise (an army for a campaign)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:07 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: he brought out his army to launch a formal attack on Yuán,

sense.def: OBI: lauch an overt large-scale destructive military campaign against what is construed as an enemy of inferior political status

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:08 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: In the south he besieged Zhèng,

sense.def: besiege (typically a city); lay siege to

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:08 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: He relieved the siege of Sòng

sense.def: cause to cease (military action); relieve ( a siege); discontinue; abolish (a monopoly)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:08 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: He relieved the siege of Sòng

sense.def: a siege 宋之衛"the siege against Sòng" ("siege" in "the siege by Sòng" would be ntab or, more explicitly, ntab - act)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:09 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: At one stroke he achieved eight things.

sense.def: undertake, carry out, do; to stage 舉事

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:09 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: was not for any other reason or for any strange thing,

sense.def: other; others'; someone else's

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:09 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: it was because he followed Hú Yǎn's strategy

sense.def: decide to follow (advice or suggestions); follow intentions; obey (laws etc); act in accordance with (a tradition etc); LY: follow (a dynasty) and take one's values from; follow (a path[which is not an ordinary act of following behind])

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:09 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: it was because he followed Hú Yǎn's strategy

sense.def: counsel, advice

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 34.29:09 [43]; jiaoshi 5i4; jishi 750; shiping 1292; jiaozhu 464; trm 393

tls:text.tls:line: and availed himself of Diǎn Jié's spine as his instrument.

sense.def: avail oneself of, use (what is not one's own)

tls:text.tls:line: The pain of ulcers and boils,

sense.def: ulcer, boil

tls:text.tls:line: The pain of ulcers and boils,

sense.def: deep-rooted hard-skinned ulcer

tls:text.tls:line: unless one punctures the bone and the marrow

sense.def: prick right down to (e.g. to the bone, as a doctor might); prick into

tls:text.tls:line: unless one punctures the bone and the marrow

sense.def: marrow of the bone

tls:text.tls:line: it irks the mind and is insupportable.

sense.def: to irritate (the mind)

tls:text.tls:line: it irks the mind and is insupportable.

sense.def: be able to bear with, be able to stand; be able to put up effective resistence

tls:text.tls:srcline: 不能使人以半寸砥石彈之。
tls:text.tls:line: one cannot make other people prick it with a half-inch stone needle.

sense.def: sharpen with a whetstone; occasionally in transferred sense: polish and cultivate

tls:text.tls:srcline: 不能使人以半寸砥石彈之。
tls:text.tls:line: one cannot make other people prick it with a half-inch stone needle.

sense.def: prick open with a needle; apply moxibustion; treat disease with stone needles

tls:text.tls:line: Now the ruler's relation to good government is also like this.

sense.def: likewise, also (sometimes with omitted antecedent, as in 盜亦有道乎？)

tls:text.tls:line: Rebellious ministers are inevitably powerful men.

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 重人者，必人主所甚親愛也。
tls:text.tls:line: Powerful men are inevitably people whom the ruler keeps close to and is fond of.

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 重人者，必人主所甚親愛也。
tls:text.tls:line: Powerful men are inevitably people whom the ruler keeps close to and is fond of.

sense.def: 甚愛之,甚禮之

tls:text.tls:srcline: 重人者，必人主所甚親愛也。
tls:text.tls:line: Powerful men are inevitably people whom the ruler keeps close to and is fond of.

sense.def: love intensely; love dearly (also as people loving ruler) 甚親愛

tls:text.tls:line: Those people whom the ruler keeps close to and is fond of

sense.def: treat with intimate concern; show proper close concern for, treat with loving care

tls:text.tls:line: this is like persuading the right thigh to cut off the left thigh.

sense.def: occasionally, in idiomatic contexts only: dismember; amputate

tls:text.tls:line: this is like persuading the right thigh to cut off the left thigh.

sense.def: thigh; specifically: thigh bone, femur; leg and loin of a deer, sheep, or other animal, prepared for, or served at, table

tls:text.tls:line: Such an undertaking leads to the certain death of the person involved,

sense.def: contrastive: himself; oneself; the person him/herself (also: 身雖無能)

tls:text.tls:line: Such an undertaking leads to the certain death of the person involved,

sense.def: in person, himself

tls:text.tls:line: Weakness and chaos have their origin in flattery.

sense.def: toadying; sycophancy; vulgar pandering

tls:text.tls:line: If the ruler is clear about this

sense.def: this situation, this fact, this state of affairs 如此

tls:text.tls:line: When the ministers are clear about this

sense.def: understand properly; develop a proper understanding of

tls:text.tls:line: then they will use up all their strength to the point of death,

sense.def: V to the degree of dying > post(ad)verbial intensifier (compare 殺／煞 in this function)

tls:text.tls:line: then one can become a true king.

sense.def: be in an objective position to, have the possibility to; be well-advised to, should, negated: must not, should not

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:01[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: As for a ruler of men

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:01[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: he keeps the law, holds people responsible for achievements

sense.def: make demands concerning (performance of duty)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:02[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: Therefore the enlightened ruler governs officials, not the people.

sense.def: the enlightened ruler; an enlightened ruler

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:02[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: and drawing a net by its rope. (.)

sense.def: pull (a bow); pull along, pull forward; drag along (a load)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:02[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: Furthermore there is the case of the granary guard who faced the fire. (.)

sense.def: there was/is a fire

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:02[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: These are cases that must be discussed.

sense.def: should by all means be V-ed

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:02[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: if he wields a whip and orders people along

sense.def: a whip

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:03[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: then it is like Zàofǔ facing frightened horses:

sense.def: frighten

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:03[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: but if he takes the place of the driver, takes the reins and the whip

sense.def: taking (someone else's) place

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:03[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: then all the horses will race along nicely. (.)

sense.def: all, each of the subjects

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.04:03[4]; jishi 758; shiping 1304; jiaozhu; Liao 118; m397

tls:text.tls:line: then all the horses will race along nicely. (.)

sense.def: gallop forward, gallop all over the place; gallop out of all control

tls:text.tls:line: Thus Zi Zhèng sat squatted on his carriage pole and sang

sense.def: sing a melody, sing a song, sing along (should this be vt[oN]???) often to accompaniment on the lute

tls:text.tls:line: in order to get up on the high bridge. (.)

sense.def: literary: wooden bridge; beam dam

tls:text.tls:line: and Guǎnzhòng economised supplies that were rotting away, and sent away unmarried women. (.)

sense.def: spinster; marriable woman, unmarried woman of an age where she could be married but is not

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: Zào Fǔ was steering his four horses.

sense.def: drive (carriage, horses)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: They were racing along and doing their turns

sense.def: race along

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

sense.def: to one's heart's content

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because he was in sole control of the regime reins and the whip.

sense.def: gain sole control of (with no negative connotations); have sole control of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because he was in sole control of the regime reins and the whip.

sense.def: reins for any horse

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because he was in sole control of the regime reins and the whip.

sense.def: whipping cane

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because he was in sole control of the regime reins and the whip.

sense.def: effective political control; effective control (over horses)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: But when the horses are terrified by an emerging swine

sense.def: be startled and frightened, terrified; get frightened away (of birds); to panic

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: this is not because the strictness of the reins and the whip are insufficient

sense.def: be unpardoning, harsh and stern; maintain strict discipline

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because their awesome authority had to be divided with the emerging swine.

sense.def: awe-inspiring authority; authoritarian legal restrictions

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:01 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: is because their awesome authority had to be divided with the emerging swine.

sense.def: domestic pig

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: Prince Yú Qí was officer in charge of the extra horse-teams.

sense.def: extra horse

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: Prince Yú Qí was officer in charge of the extra horse-teams.

sense.def: driver

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: this is because he was in sole control of fodder and water.

sense.def: gain sole control of (with no negative connotations); have sole control of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: this is because he was in sole control of fodder and water.

sense.def: hay, fodder (for domestic animals)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: this is because he was in sole control of fodder and water.

sense.def: public benefits, public advantage; what is generally useful, profitability; usefulness

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: But the reason why the horses trespass on the garden pond

sense.def: guo1: cross over (a river, a bridge); transgress (a territory); pass through; pass by (a place or a person) PRONOUNCIATION!

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: But the reason why the horses trespass on the garden pond

sense.def: garden, typically gardened by a gardener, not necessarily with a fence

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: But the reason why the horses trespass on the garden pond

sense.def: artificial lake; winding pond surrounding a platform coming close in form to a moat; meandering lake (on the edges of Heaven)深池，曲池；天池

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:02 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: it is because they have to share his generosity with the garden moat.

sense.def: overt charismatic generosity, ability to display magnanimity; goodwill

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 35.06:03 [7]; jiaoshi 592; jishi 755; shiping 1306; jiaozhu 472; m399

tls:text.tls:line: are the best charioteers in the world

sense.def: do the driving of a carriage; act as driver

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 46.05:01; jiaoshi 99; jishi 952; jiaozhu 627; shiping 1599; Liao 2.245

tls:text.tls:line: The learned men of today quote the panegyrical talk in books and documents

sense.def: bundle of bamboo strips for writing on; document; recordsbamboo or wooden strips woven together as a mat (the character 冊 depicts this). Ordinarily hemp was used for string, but silk could be used for especially valuable writings; perhaps leather ( 韋 ) was used in a similar way. On each strip were cut triangular indentations to keep the string in place. It was common to have two or three strings ( 編, 道 ). The last strip served as a center around which the 冊 was wrapped. On the back of the first strip the title of the 冊 could be written. Each strip could have a serial number. 冊 and 策 appear to be used interchangably, except that wheras 策 is a general word for strips of any length women in the above way, 策 (cf. its original meaning of "whip") is preferably made of rather long strips. 冊 is not used for counting written material. [JP]STATIONARY

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and the teachers of the people are the police;

sense.def: minor law enforcement officer; police officer; magistrate

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and the teachers of the people are the police;

sense.def: 人師,民師 teacher, guiding authority; sometimes specifically: music master

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: there are no fierce exploits of private swordsmen,

sense.def: acts of courage in defense of what is right

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and cutting off enemy heads counts as valour.

sense.def: valour; boldness

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: will move along the track of the law in what they say

sense.def: engage in public discussion or dialogue

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:01; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: will move along the track of the law in what they say

sense.def: follow the standard set by (the law) 軌於, keep in accordance with

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Thus when there is no trouble, the state is rich,

sense.def: for this objective reason: therefore

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: These are called the resources of a king.

sense.def: goods; resources, existing resources

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: One must first accumulate the resources of a king

sense.def: (foster up>) amass (supplies); harbour and accumulate (resentment)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and then latch on to the weaknesses of enemy states.

sense.def: continue to; latch on to; continue the tradition of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and then latch on to the weaknesses of enemy states.

sense.def: openings for attack> weakness

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: If one is to surpass the Five Ancestors or to equal the Three Kings

sense.def: surpass, exceed (the proper rank); excel

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: If one is to surpass the Five Ancestors or to equal the Three Kings

sense.def: equal, be as good as

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.13:02; jiaoshi 50f; jishi 1967; jiaozhu 674; shiping1735; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: one absolutely has to follow this method.

sense.def: method; model ( we can say cǐ fǎ 此法 "this method")

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Nowadays things are not like that.

sense.def: the present, the present time; the present age

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Nowadays things are not like that.

sense.def: When it comes to N, then on the other hand

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: The citizens behave recklessly at home

sense.def: citizen; citizenry

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: The citizens behave recklessly at home

sense.def: be unrestrained

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: The citizens behave recklessly at home

sense.def: be unrestrained

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: The citizens behave recklessly at home

sense.def: be unrestrained, be licentious, be self-indulgent

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and the talkers deploy their power play aboad.

sense.def: engage in public discussion or dialogue

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Those abroad and at home are all equally wicked

sense.def: be in accordance with each other in (some aspect), correspond; in accordance with

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Surely that is a dangerous state of affairs.

sense.def: surely? 不亦。。。乎

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:01; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: or they are doing their utmost to avenge some hostile act

sense.def: who are mortal enemies

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:02; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: The vertical alliance

sense.def: vertical alliance

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:02; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: serves one strong state in order to attack a number of weak states.

sense.def: that which is strong> superpower

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:02; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: serves one strong state in order to attack a number of weak states.

sense.def: that which is weak, a weak state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:02; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: "If we do not serve the big power

sense.def: the big one; a big power; what is big; specifically: a big state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:02; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then when we meet the enemy that will be disastrous."

sense.def: suffer; be at the receiving end of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: When one is serving a big power

sense.def: the big one; a big power; what is big; specifically: a big state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and it remains uncertain whether this will lead to concrete results

sense.def: real object; real result, concrete result

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then one must offer up one's maps and leave them with the big power

sense.def: geographical map; map, official map showing territories as belonging to their rightful governing authorities

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then one must offer up one's maps and leave them with the big power

sense.def: pass on to, give to; hand over (for keeping); entrust to

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: one hands up one's official seals and asks for military support.

sense.def: offer up; deliver; hand up and give away, surrender, hand over (to the opponent or to an authority); deliver (results, in service of a ruler)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: one hands up one's official seals and asks for military support.

sense.def: official seal as a symbol of administrative authority

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: one hands up one's official seals and asks for military support.

sense.def: ask for 請兵 "ask for soldiers"

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Once one has handed up one's map then one's territory is decimated,

sense.def: hand over; formal: give to a person of higher status; make an offering to a superior (of something)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: once one has offered up one's official seals then one's reputation is low.

sense.def: be lowly, humble, hold low social status, menial; have a low status; be on a low level; also of one's reputation: be low

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Once one's territory is decimated then the state is decimated,

sense.def: state in the sense of territory of the state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: once one's reputation is low then one's administration is in turmoil.

sense.def: administration of a state, public administration; administrative measure; administrative method; administrative tasks and problems; administrative practice

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:03; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then one has instead lost territory and reduced one's administration to chaos.

sense.def: cause to be chaotic, reduce to chaos; mix something chaotically into (something else); wreak havoc in; disrupt

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:04; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Those who speak up for the vertical alliance

sense.def: articulate, express; propose; maintain, propose as true; pronounce on, speak up on, speak of (other's bad points); (abstractly) speak of (orally or in writing); inform of; suggest (often formally at court)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:04; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: "If we do not rescue the small states and go on to attack the big one

sense.def: what is small, something small; specifically refers to: small state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:04; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Before they have seen concrete results of saving the small states

sense.def: real object; real result, concrete result

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:04; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: they are raising armies and facing the big power as an enemy.

sense.def: resist as an enemy, equal as an opponent

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:04; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: When they are rescuing a small state they cannot necessarily survive

sense.def: subsist, persist, continue to exist, remain; survive

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: And if there are divisions in one's camp one will be at the mercy of the big state.

sense.def: disagreements, divisions; estrangement

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: And if there are divisions in one's camp one will be at the mercy of the big state.

sense.def: vigorous, strong; powerful (of states)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: And if there are divisions in one's camp one will be at the mercy of the big state.

sense.def: be controlled by 制於

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and if one withdraws to a defensive position one's city will be conquered.

sense.def: be taken, be conquered

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: If one rescues the small states and works for a vertical alliance

sense.def: vertical alliance

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: If one rescues the small states and works for a vertical alliance

sense.def: what is small, something small; specifically refers to: small state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: one will lose one's territory and see one's army defeated.

sense.def: cause (one's own army) to fail; cause the failure of (a plan or a strategy)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Thus when one serves one strong state

sense.def: for this objective reason: therefore

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Thus when one serves one strong state

sense.def: that which is strong> superpower

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:05; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then one will have powerful alien men holding office in one's country;

sense.def: powerful

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Before there is concrete benefit to the state

sense.def: be brought into existence and solidly established

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: they will be enfeoffed with territory and have abundant stipends;

sense.def: enfeoffed (territory), held as a feof

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: the ruler may then have a humble status,

sense.def: the ruler (in a hypothetical case); a (hypothetical) ruler

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and the ministers enjoy all honours.

sense.def: a minister; ministers (non-referential)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and the ministers enjoy all honours.

sense.def: be regarded as noble, be honoured> be distinguished, enjoy elevated status (also of things like meritorious achievements)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: but the private families will get rich.

sense.def: get rich; get richer; try to get richer

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:06; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then they will enjoy lasting political importance because of their power;

sense.def: for a long time, for any length of time; forever; in the long run

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: When the ruler listens to the arguments from his ministers,

sense.def: advice to do something; persuasions

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: then even before a project is completed ranks and stipends are already abundant.

sense.def: reach a level appropriate for a noble person, become more noble

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: who would not use arguments which work like stringed arrows

sense.def: whoever? i.e. no one

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: who would not use arguments which work like stringed arrows

sense.def: arrow-like

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: who would not use arguments which work like stringed arrows

sense.def: arrow-like ???

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and hope for the best afterwards?

sense.def: hope for the best

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Thus they ruin the state and ruin the ruler

sense.def: smash to pieces; ruin;

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Thus they ruin the state and ruin the ruler

sense.def: (cause to be ruined>) to ruin (a state or a ruler, one's peson)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: but still the ruler listens to the baseless arguments of the talkers.

sense.def: engage in public discussion or dialogue

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:07; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: but still the ruler listens to the baseless arguments of the talkers.

sense.def: floating; loose, baseless (explanations); undefined

tls:text.tls:srcline: 是人君不明乎公私之利，

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:08; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: This is because the ruler is not clear about public and private profit

sense.def: understand properly; develop a proper understanding of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:08; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: and at the very least I can effect a peace."

sense.def: be at peace and secure, be safe; be at ease; find peace; be poised

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:08; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Now a king

sense.def: a king, kings, the hypothetical king in question 王者之後也 "was a descendent of a king"

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:09; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Good political order and political strength cannot depend on through foreign activities,

sense.def: be held responsible for, be exposed to demands

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:09; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: they are matters to do with internal administration.

sense.def: within the family, within the household: private; within the state: internal; within the court; inner

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:09; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: they are matters to do with internal administration.

sense.def: administration of a state, public administration; administrative measure; administrative method; administrative tasks and problems; administrative practice

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.14:09; jiaoshi53; jishi 1067; jiaozhu 675; shiping1741; Watson 111

tls:text.tls:line: Now if one does not use the philosophy of law in internal politics

sense.def: now if for example; suppose

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: A popular saying goes:

sense.def: rustic, vulgar and ignorant, crude

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: A popular saying goes:

sense.def: proverb

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: "If you have long sleeves you are good at dancing,/

sense.def: broad sleeve which may serve as a pocket

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: and if you have a lot of money you will be a good merchant."/

sense.def: have much; have many; contain many 多金

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: and if you have a lot of money you will be a good merchant."/

sense.def: excel at, be good at

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: and if you have a lot of money you will be a good merchant."/

sense.def: engage in trade

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 49.15:01; jiaoshi 54; jishi 1068; jiaozhu 677; shiping 1741; Watson 114

tls:text.tls:line: This means that abundant resources make it easy to do work.

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 50.04:03; jiaoshi 10; jishi 1090; jiaozhu 687; shiping 1773; Watson 121

tls:text.tls:line: Those who collect books

sense.def: bundle of bamboo strips for writing on; document; recordsbamboo or wooden strips woven together as a mat (the character 冊 depicts this). Ordinarily hemp was used for string, but silk could be used for especially valuable writings; perhaps leather ( 韋 ) was used in a similar way. On each strip were cut triangular indentations to keep the string in place. It was common to have two or three strings ( 編, 道 ). The last strip served as a center around which the 冊 was wrapped. On the back of the first strip the title of the 冊 could be written. Each strip could have a serial number. 冊 and 策 appear to be used interchangably, except that wheras 策 is a general word for strips of any length women in the above way, 策 (cf. its original meaning of "whip") is preferably made of rather long strips. 冊 is not used for counting written material. [JP]STATIONARY

tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:02; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and can pull carts over a long distance

sense.def: pull (a bow); pull along, pull forward; drag along (a load)

tls:text.tls:srcline: 所以制天下而征諸侯者，

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:02; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: the means by which they control the world and chastise the feudal lords

sense.def: launch a military campaign against; chastise, go on a punitive expedition against

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:02; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: this means that the ruler loses his effective strength.

sense.def: thus under such circumstances, then under such circumstances

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:03; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: The reason why tigers and panthers can win against men

sense.def: overcome, win against; compete successfully with; be superior to; overpower

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:03; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and catch wild beasts

sense.def: detain; take prisoner; iussive: have someone detained, apprehended; get hold of (not necessarily for detention, but only for questioning etc)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:03; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and catch wild beasts

sense.def: generally: four-legged animal of a certain size which are liable to run away when hunted; 百獸"all manner of wild animals"; NB: one may also rear wild animals in parks 養獸

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:03; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: then men can certainly gain control of them.

sense.def: dominate systematically; have and keep effective and systematic control of; exercise political control over; organise occasionally inchoative; gain control over

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:03; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: Now the people who have great power

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and they did not capture them back in good time

sense.def: in good time, at an early stage; at an earlier stage, at a sufficiently early stage

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: so as a result they died and their state was lost.

sense.def: contrastive: himself; oneself; the person him/herself (also: 身雖無能)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: all understand the mistakes of the ruler of Sòng and of Duke Jiǎn,

sense.def: lucidly; openly, clearly; perfectly clearly 明知

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: all understand the mistakes of the ruler of Sòng and of Duke Jiǎn,

sense.def: minor transgression; wrongdoing, wrong practice; formal offense

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and if they do not understand their own mistakes

sense.def: get a clear vision of, come to understand; understand the significance of; oappreciate properly; become enlightened to

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.01:04; jiaoshi 787; jishi 1118; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i22; Liao 2.318

tls:text.tls:line: and if they do not understand their own mistakes

sense.def: inadvertent mistake or transgression; inadvertent mistake (of a superior), insouciance; transgression; faulty point

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:01; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: cannot coexist.

sense.def: be incompatible

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:01; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: cannot coexist.

sense.def: be consistent with (each other), coincide 相容

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:01; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: When the ruler has freemen who understand political method

sense.def: professional, properly qualified

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:01; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and those familiar with the ruler do not dare to sell political influence;

sense.def: close associates (of a ruler); confidantes

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:01; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and those familiar with the ruler do not dare to sell political influence;

sense.def: political influence, political weight; political power

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:02; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: to guard their own profit;

sense.def: make safe plans for; guard on all sides

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:02; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: if the entourage and the confidants form their factions and gangs

sense.def: form friendship groups

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:02; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: if the entourage and the confidants form their factions and gangs

sense.def: form factions 相與比周

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:02; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and are, under prevailing conditions, incompatible with the incumbents of power,

sense.def: both the subjects (often indefinite) together

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:03; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and go against the legal proposals of the entourage

sense.def: civil law case; legal proposals

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:03; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: disregard the danger to their lives

sense.def: to put up with, to face; be exposed to (difficulties etc)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:03; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: disregard the danger to their lives

sense.def: death

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: The enlightened ruler assigns rank and stipends according to concrete achievements

sense.def: the enlightened ruler; an enlightened ruler

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: The enlightened ruler assigns rank and stipends according to concrete achievements

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: Those whom he promotes will always have talent

sense.def: moral distinction; moral worthiness; talent; moral excellence, moral talent

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and those whom he employs will always have abilities.

sense.def: capability; physical capability, concrete technical capability; potential, capacity 人各有能

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: then requests on behalf of private families will stop.

sense.def: special requests; special pleas 左右之請 "special requests from entourage"

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and those who have abilities will occupy important offices,

sense.def: capability; physical capability, concrete technical capability; potential, capacity 人各有能

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:04; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and how can they fail to rush forth against the enemies of the state?

sense.def: intensely; acutely; stronly, vigorously; eagerly, energetically

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: how can they fail to stand in the way of the private families

sense.def: how? 焉得儉"How could he get to count as stingy?" 焉辟"how can one avoid?"

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: how can they fail to stand in the way of the private families

sense.def: interfere with; confuse and stand in the way of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and how can they fail to do their best to be clean and pure?

sense.def: aim for

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and how can they fail to do their best to be clean and pure?

sense.def: be pure of mind

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and how can they fail to do their best to be clean and pure?

sense.def: moral purity

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and to scatter adherents of the private families.

sense.def: what belongs to a certain category; the likes of 有血氣之屬

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: if somebody knows something, he will listen to him.

sense.def: by some chance, by any chance, as it happened

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: But at court, if he discusses such proposals with his confidantes

sense.def: sort out and discuss, often in writing; argue; account for, give an account of; demonstrate

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and listens to these confidantes without any regard to their level of knowledge,

sense.def: sometimes: degree of wisdom 愚人之智

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:05; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: this is like discussing wisdom with the stupid.

sense.def: a stupid person; simpleton, dullard

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:06; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: he will treat someone politely if he has certain talents.

sense.def: by some chance, by any chance, as it happened

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:06; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: he will treat someone politely if he has certain talents.

sense.def: show ritual respect for (a person), treat politely; show public respect for (behaviour or a skill) 大禮之 SEE ALSO THE ENTRY UNDER "RESPECT" WHICH IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM THIS!

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:07; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: and the freemen of talent have judged their actions by the incompetent

sense.def: assess by certain standards

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:08; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: These three men

sense.def: 此二人者

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:08; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: These three men

sense.def: after number phrase 三家者， 之數物者

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:08; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: but they did not escape the disaster of death,

sense.def: avoid; escape from (something); keep away from (somebody)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:08; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: but they did not escape the disaster of death,

sense.def: death

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:09; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: who of them would face the dangers these three men succumbed to

sense.def: whoever? i.e. no one

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:09; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: to offer up their knowledge and their ability?

sense.def: come forward with and present

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:09; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: to offer up their knowledge and their ability?

sense.def: intellect; intellectual competence, professional competence; intelligence, intellectual capacity

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 52.02:09; jiaoshi 789; jishi 1119; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i25; Liao 2.320; m 5i4

tls:text.tls:line: to offer up their knowledge and their ability?

sense.def: capability; physical capability, concrete technical capability; potential, capacity 人各有能

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:01; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: then the laws will not be tampered with;

sense.def: get changed by an administrative decision

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:01; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: If one those who have achievements

sense.def: give responsibilities to; give responsibilities for something to someone, put in charge of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:01; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: If one those who have achievements

sense.def: meritorious [effort]

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:01; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: if one goes by impressive excellence

sense.def: those who are capable and competent; those who are excellent; those who are more distinguished/of greater excellence

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:02; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: In the practice of the law, when judging local cases,

sense.def: locally, parochially

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:02; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: In the practice of the law, when judging local cases,

sense.def: take decisions; take the political decisions; make legal decisions

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.01:02; jiaoshi i26; jishi 1122; jiaozhu 705; shiping 1i34; Liao 2.322

tls:text.tls:line: and if government action is dragged out one will lose territory.

sense.def: the day after; after a day; after a delay

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:01; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: if the peasants will relax their efforts and the wicked will win out

sense.def: slacken, relax; weaken; relax one's efforts

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:01; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: then one's state is bound to lose territory.

sense.def: one's state as territory

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:01; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: If the people have more than enough to eat

sense.def: Note that Lù Démíng reads this meaning as sì in several places of 經典釋文: provisions; food supply; staple food; food for general sustenance while at home; (e.g. beg for) something to eat; food supplies; fodder (e.g. for horses)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: If one is bound to have to use one's physical strength

sense.def: make use of; make proper or meaningful use of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: then the peasants will not be lazy.

sense.def: peasant; agricultural worker, agriculturalist

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: then the peasants will not be lazy.

sense.def: be remiss; be lazy in performance of one's duty; be listless in performance

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: If a three-inch tube has no bottom

sense.def: bottom (of a beaker etc)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: one cannot fill it with liquid.

sense.def: be filled up

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:03; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: this means that one makes plans with consummate intelligence

sense.def: this (particular aforementioned abstract but definite) item

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:04; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: then the number of those who need to be called to order is reduced

sense.def: become more economical

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:04; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: This is called getting rid of government through government,

sense.def: this (particular aforementioned abstract but definite) item

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:04; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: and when it keeps the troops in the barracks and does not attack it is bound to become rich.

sense.def: hold down, keep with one

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:05; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: As for matters in the court

sense.def: royal court (apparently never used to refer to any concrete court of a concrete king)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:05; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: If one has come up with the results one will get rank and stipend.

sense.def: achieve (public and visible success) in the service of someone or something; realise; put into practice through commendable effort in some service

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:05; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: This is called governing with a method.

sense.def: definite technique, precise method; strategem, trick

tls:text.tls:srcline:
以言攻者，
出十喪百。

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.02:05; jiaoshi i27; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 706; shiping 1i36

tls:text.tls:line: if one attacks with words then for ten sallies one loses one hundred times.

sense.def: to lose; lose by death; lose all control of (one's state); lose all interest in

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.04:01; jiaoshi i29; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 711; shiping 1i42

tls:text.tls:line: and the people will not die for rewards.

sense.def: be prepared to die for; die for

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.04:01; jiaoshi i29; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 711; shiping 1i42

tls:text.tls:line: When benefits come from one opening

sense.def: hole, opening (also abstract)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 53.04:01; jiaoshi i29; jishi 1123; jiaozhu 711; shiping 1i42

tls:text.tls:line: one's state will have no rivals;

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
