tls:text.tls:line: When laws are severe they get through to to men's real inner feelings,

sense.def: human feelings (often definite: the human feelings); real ways of thinking (of a given person or persons); (sometimes general:) public opinion, (even:) public demand

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: to achieve what they desire;

sense.def: achieve, manage to bring into existence, lead to; insist on bring to completion, bring to fruition; make the utmost use of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: but their likes and dislikes on the other hand

sense.def: predilection; likes (versus dislikes); preferences

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: but their likes and dislikes on the other hand

sense.def: hatred; dislikes (versus likes); bad feelings; hating people

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: are something that is within the control of the leadership:

sense.def: dominate systematically; have and keep effective and systematic control of; exercise political control over; organise occasionally inchoative; gain control over

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: The people like benefits and stipends

sense.def: nominalising suffix after nominal elements, marking subjects that are topics at the same time 仁者 "as for goodness" (Note the occasional presence of demonstrative pronouns as in 彼聖人者)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: The people like benefits and stipends

sense.def: like (something); be fond of (something); LY 4.6: be truly fond of (goodness)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: The people like benefits and stipends

sense.def: benefits and emoluments

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: If the leadership is in control of what they like and dislike

sense.def: ZUO Xiang 29: hold the reins of control over;

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: so as to control the people's exertion of their strength.

sense.def: control (others); have control over (things)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: then his public projects are not the kinds of things it is appropriate to get wrong.

sense.def: go wrong by mistake; get things wrong by mistake; make a slip

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: If in governing people you do not regard it as good to stick to the law,

sense.def: to reduce to order; to put in order (the administration etc); to be in administrative charge of, to deal with, take care of; to be in charge of, take administrative responsibility for; to regulate, make regular, control (as breath)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: If in governing people you do not regard it as good to stick to the law,

sense.def: hold onto as the crucial thing

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.01:03; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 718; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: then this is not to have a law at all.

sense.def: THEN + SUCH> then in such a case; then such a person; then; then as for such behaviour; then this is; then this means that; then this leads to [Note that this is not claimed to be a word, just a collocation which it is useful to study.]

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: Thus among the principles guiding the sorting out of political chaos

sense.def: take political charge of; get to deal with

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: Thus among the principles guiding the sorting out of political chaos

sense.def: something chaotic; a chaotic state; a chaotic situation, political chaos

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: and yet some states survive and others are ruined.

sense.def: someone =或; some... others

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: and yet some states survive and others are ruined.

sense.def: subsist, persist, continue to exist, remain; survive

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: and yet some states survive and others are ruined.

sense.def: lose out; be ruined, be annihilated, be ruined

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: If they are ruined

sense.def: lose out; be ruined, be annihilated, be ruined

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: one does not apportion these properly.

sense.def: distribute, give out; apportion; allot, mete out, parcel out

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:01; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: there will always be an apportioning of punishments and rewards:

sense.def: the apportioning, distribution; allotment

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: Some use different standards to do the apportioning,

sense.def: the apportioning, distribution; allotment

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: When it comes to the proper apportioning by the perceptive ruler

sense.def: astute, clever

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: When it comes to the proper apportioning by the perceptive ruler

sense.def: the apportioning, distribution; allotment

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: this is an independent apportioning.

sense.def: independent

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: this is an independent apportioning.

sense.def: the apportioning, distribution; allotment

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: As a result the people take the law seriously and stand in awe of prohibitions.

sense.def: stand in fear of; fear, be very much afraid of and at the same time in awe of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: They hope they will not have to suffer for crimes and they dare not expect undeserved rewards.

sense.def: fail to, not; not to

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: They hope they will not have to suffer for crimes and they dare not expect undeserved rewards.

sense.def: be exposed to (something harmful; a criminal charge); suffer as a result of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.02:02; jiaoshi i31; jishi 1141; jiaozhu 719; shiping 1860

tls:text.tls:line: the people do their duty.

sense.def: work; do one's work; work hard as one should

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: Therefore in an extremely well-governed state

sense.def: for this objective reason: therefore

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: Therefore in an extremely well-governed state

sense.def: extremely; to the highest degree; be the most (marker of superlative)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: This is because the laws link up with human feelings

sense.def: have a profound connection with; keep close contact with

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: This is because the laws link up with human feelings

sense.def: human feelings (often definite: the human feelings); real ways of thinking (of a given person or persons); (sometimes general:) public opinion, (even:) public demand

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: and they connect with the very principles of good government.

sense.def: interrelate propfoundly

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: and they connect with the very principles of good government.

sense.def: pattern of things, natural principle; Principle; reasonable principle, reason

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: How is one, then, to get rid of subtle forms of wickedness?

sense.def: hidden subtle

tls:text.tls:srcline: 其務令之相規其情者也。

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: It is by trying to make people observe each others real feelings.

sense.def: spy out; catch an intellectual glimpse of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:01; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: And how is one to make them observe each other?

sense.def: spy out; catch an intellectual glimpse of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: If a prohibition will get them involved

sense.def: IF

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: then the neighbourhood will not fail to observe each other,

sense.def: will certainly; willy nilly have to; inevitably will; certainly would have

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: then the neighbourhood will not fail to observe each other,

sense.def: be linked to (the punishment), suffer the same

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: only too much afraid that they may not escape punishment.

sense.def: be afraid that V; be afraid to V

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: only too much afraid that they may not escape punishment.

sense.def: avoid the worst; go free of punishment, go scot free; go free of misfortune; escape menial labour; escape (from trouble)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: In this way people will be careful with themselves and they will watch others,

sense.def: be diligent and careful with respect to (oneself)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: they will divulge secrets regarding wicked plans.

sense.def: disclose (incriminating) facts

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: Those who denunciate transgressions should be regarded as innocent

sense.def: avoid (something); try to keep away from; keep away from

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:02; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: and they should receive rewards.

sense.def: (receive>) be on the receiving end of Nab-ing 受公仲侈之怨也(!)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:03; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: then all sorts of wickedness will come out into the open.

sense.def: people or things of the N kind

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:03; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: then all sorts of wickedness will come out into the open.

sense.def: (of disease) break out, become virulent; come out into the open

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:03; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: When it comes to wickedness even small instances will not be tolerated.

sense.def: put up with, tolerate; forgive the crimes of, disregard the crimes of

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.03:03; jiaoshi i32; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 720; shiping 1864

tls:text.tls:line: When it comes to wickedness even small instances will not be tolerated.

sense.def: what is tenuous> a tenuous instance; what is tenuous or insubstantial;

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:01; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: is to rely on administrative technique and not to rely on people.

sense.def: rely on

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:01; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: is to rely on administrative technique and not to rely on people.

sense.def: definite technique, precise method; strategem, trick

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:01; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: it is when one does not use public praise that people avoid transgressions.

sense.def: commit an offense, make a mistake

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:01; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: And that there is bound to be good order in the land

sense.def: what is within the boundaries; the state

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:01; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and is unable to constrain them or put a stop to them

sense.def: constrain, restrain, contain; hold back; defend onself against

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: One's attacking oneself is because of those men,

sense.def: attack (oneself)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: Thus a state in which the art of government prevails

sense.def: method of government, art of government, statecraft; political philosophy, philosophy of government; professional skill in government

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: does away with speeches and relies on the law.

sense.def: get rid of, discard; dispense with (often with abstract objects)

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.04:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu720f; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: does away with speeches and relies on the law.

sense.def: rely on

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)

tls:text.tls:line: the root of good government is lost.

sense.def: abstract and metaphorical: root; basis; karmic basis (BUDDH.: orig. tr. SANSKRIT indriya or mūla; see http://www.buddhism-dict.net/cgi-bin/xpr-ddb.pl?68.xml+id('b6839'))

tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

sense.def: abstract and metaphorical: root; basis; karmic basis (BUDDH.: orig. tr. SANSKRIT indriya or mūla; see http://www.buddhism-dict.net/cgi-bin/xpr-ddb.pl?68.xml+id('b6839'))

tls:text.tls:line: If these two kinds of ambiguous situation exist one certainly will lose both [i.e. both rewards and punishments].

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: If these two kinds of ambiguous situation exist one certainly will lose both [i.e. both rewards and punishments].

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:02; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: If these two kinds of ambiguous situation exist one certainly will lose both [i.e. both rewards and punishments].

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

故愚、
怯、勇、
慧相連，

tls:text.tls:srcline:
故愚、
怯、勇、
慧相連，

tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: Thus the stupid, the gutless, the brave and the lazy

sense.def: the cowardly

tls:text.tls:srcline:
故愚、
怯、勇、
慧相連，

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: Thus the stupid, the gutless, the brave and the lazy

sense.def: paragon of courage; the brave

tls:text.tls:srcline:
故愚、
怯、勇、
慧相連，

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: Thus the stupid, the gutless, the brave and the lazy

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: go ahead to preach their empty ways to the vulgar

sense.def: the vulgar; the vulgar people; the common people

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and punishments and fines are not applied to the culprits deserving execution.

sense.def: various kinds of penalties and punishments

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and punishments and fines are not applied to the culprits deserving execution.

sense.def: use (something N1) on (a goal N2) 加兵於齊 HN: 不能將加誅於子

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and punishments and fines are not applied to the culprits deserving execution.

sense.def: deserving execution

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: how can punishments and rewards avoid being ambiguous?

sense.def: how? (idiomatic in 安得 "how can one get to?", 安敢"how would I dare to?")

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:03; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: how can punishments and rewards avoid being ambiguous?

sense.def: have room for, be able to accomodate

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)

tls:text.tls:line: how can those entrusted with public projects perform their tasks?

sense.def: how? (idiomatic in 安得 "how can one get to?", 安敢"how would I dare to?")

sense.def: have been messed up so as to be in disarray; be in turmoil

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:05; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and when the Way of the land is all misguided,

sense.def: be mistaken

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:05; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and when the Way of the land is all misguided,

sense.def: have been got wrong, be in wrong shape

tls:line.title: 韓非子(en)
tls:line.loc: HF 55.05:05; jiaoshi i34; jishi 1142; jiaozhu 721; shiping 1867

tls:text.tls:line: and when the Way of the land is all misguided,

sense.def: be mistaken or misguided (said both of words and of people)
